sourceTitle: 分析项目视图并生成进展报告 (2)
modifications: Expose mode/theme controller for the host toolbar.
Hide duplicate mode/theme controls only when embedded; standalone controls remain available.
Remove duplicate branding and summary labels in the embedded report; hide its presentation masthead and reclaim header spacing.
Use Paper & Ink as the default and fallback theme while preserving saved theme choices.
Center report navigation with wider tabs and adapt presentation controls without wrapping button labels.
Keep report navigation labels at 14px with 20px line height across screen widths.
Rename the default theme to Feishu Project and set its primary color, accent washes, chart primary, and preview swatches to #5E36EF.
Restart presentation on the first slide on entry and stop restoring a previously saved slide index.
